Messages.Author: Justin Fang
Messages.Body:
The damage from Daring the Dawn is dealt "after the action is complete".
So, if a vampire calls a vote of Banishment on itself with a DtD, and the
vote passes, does the vampire take the damage?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Heh. I guess not.

General rule: uncontrolled vampires are not "wounded" by damage - and they
do not burn blood to heal. I'll run this by the RT for verification.

Good question to start a morning with. Thanks. :-)

Messages.Author: FADE FX
Messages.Body:
yes, one point in torper.
If the vampire has no blood. Burn it !

Messages.Author: Andrew Loder
Messages.Body:
But the banished vampire isn't in torpor, the vamp is
uncontrolled (exactly like when vampires are being
influenced) and I don't think (as LSJ said) that you can
damage an uncontrolled vampire (sure you can manipulate how
much blood is on them but you cant actually damage them)

Andrew
